culpritSource.quote: In the car, Conan tranquilizes Kogoro and reveals that the culprit is Satoshi Komaki. Turns out that the evidence collected from the murder case which killed Ryohei Oi is exactly the same as what Satoshi mentioned at the bar, which also means that Satoshi is the one who murdered Ryohei. This time, Satoshi killed Lisa and left the same evidence to frame Hara.

summary.en:
Kogoro and Conan are walking around, when they see some police cars in front of a apartment. They decide to help the investigation.

Location: Apartment

Victim: Lisa Hewitson
